name.description: The name it is known by, in plain letters and digits; it cannot pass for Fyniq or a known brand.

outside_singapore.description: True when it processes outside Singapore: a transfer to assess under the PDPA before an Owner allows it (CMP-PD-06).

processing_location.description: Where the publisher processes what it reads.

publisher.description: Who publishes it, as you have verified it yourself: Fyniq does not fetch or check it.

publisher_url.description: The publisher's own https address, shown to the Owner; never fetched.

purpose.description: What the organisation uses it for, for the data inventory.
examples: Ask questions about the management accounts from an AI assistant

redirect_uris.description: The exact https (or loopback) addresses it signs people in on: no wildcard, query or fragment.

items.description: An exact https or loopback redirect URI.
